posts.text:
In just three years, the Communists flipped nearly the entire map of China from Nationalist blue to red — one of the fastest total reversals of a civil war in modern history.

a thread 🧵🗺️
1/ August 1947: the Nationalists (KMT), backed by the US, hold almost all of China. The Communists (CCP) control scattered pockets in the northeast, boosted by captured Japanese weapons via the USSR.
2/ January 1949: after the Communists win the massive Huaihai and Liaoshen campaigns, the map has already flipped — red now covers Manchuria and most of the north.
3/ Nationalist forces were larger on paper but riddled with corruption, hyperinflation, and low morale. Whole KMT armies surrendered or defected rather than fight — accelerating the collapse.
4/ October 1949: Mao proclaims the People's Republic of China in Beijing while fighting still continues in the south and west. The government, not the war, gets ahead of the map.

5/ By September 1950, only Tibet remains outside CCP control (it would be incorporated the following year) — and the Nationalist government has fled to the island of Taiwan, where it still governs today.

6/ A war that started with the Nationalists holding nearly the whole country ended, three years later, with them holding one island.

What's the fastest territorial reversal you know of? Follow @forummapping for more maps like this.
